correlationId.title: Correlation ID
correlationId.description: Optional opaque correlation identifier; echoed back in response and persisted to SF_AgenticInvocation__c.

handlerClass.title: Handler Class Name
handlerClass.description: Dispatch target. Bare value or prefixed: apex:|flow:|ip:|dr:|agent:|dml:|query:. Must be allow-listed in SF_AgenticGateway_Allow__mdt. Identified as handlerClass.

payloadJson.title: Payload JSON
payloadJson.description: JSON-encoded payload string. Format depends on handlerClass contract. Optional batch[] array supported when CMDT MaxBatchSize > 1. Identified as payloadJson.
